title: América Latina al entrar en el nuevo siglo
goal: Read about the December 31, 1999 handover of the Panama Canal, and a closing look back across the whole course -- from pre-Columbian societies to this symbolic end of the century.
grammar: América Latina al entrar en el nuevo siglo

items: Explain what happened at noon on December 31, 1999.
State what Panama's 1903 independence had been linked to.
Describe how Panama handled operating the canal afterward.
Summarize the course's overall historical arc.
